narrative.overview:
KeelBill Ledger is a clean, efficient, and professional billing workspace that feels modern without being trendy. Every screen is organized, trustworthy, and effortless to use. The design combines a refined slate-grey and white foundation with subtle emerald accents, generous spacing, clear typography, and minimal borders.

The visual language follows a precision over decoration philosophy: every element serves a clear business purpose. Professionalism, clarity, and trust are communicated through consistent layouts, clean typography, balanced spacing, and subtle colors rather than unnecessary decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Slate-grey and white foundation with emerald green as the meaningful accent
Generously rounded corners (16–28px) creating a soft, approachable feel
Card-based layout with subtle borders and light shadows
Clean Inter typeface with tight tracking on headings
Status-driven color coding: emerald for success, amber for warnings, rose for errors
Responsive design that adapts from desktop to mobile with table-to-card transformations

rules.name: The Emerald Restraint Rule
rules.body: Emerald green is the voice of financial confidence. It appears on primary actions, success states, and positive indicators — never as decoration. Its rarity is what gives it weight.

rules.name: The Neutral Foundation Rule
rules.body: Slate grey and white carry 90% of the interface. Color is reserved for meaning: status, action, or error.

rules.name: The Tight Heading Rule
rules.body: All headings use tracking-tight (letter-spacing -0.015em) for a refined, modern appearance. Body text uses default tracking for maximum readability.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Most surfaces rely on borders and background contrast for separation. Shadows appear only on elevated cards and dropdowns.

rules.name: The Border Opacity Rule
rules.body: Card borders use border-slate-200/80 (80% opacity) for a softer, more refined edge than solid borders.

dos: Do use emerald green for primary actions and positive financial states — let its restraint give it meaning.
Do maintain 16–28px corner radius on cards and inputs for the soft, approachable character.
Do use tracking-tight on all headings for a refined, modern appearance.
Do prefer borders and background contrast over shadows for card separation.
Do keep form labels at 14px medium weight with 2px bottom margin for clear association.
Do use status chips (rounded-full) with tinted backgrounds for visual state communication.
Do ensure inputs are 16px font size on mobile to prevent iOS zoom.
donts: Don't use emerald green as a background or decorative color — reserve it for action and meaning.
Don't add gradients, excessive shadows, or decorative elements that don't serve a business purpose.
Don't use sharp corners (0–4px radius) on primary UI elements — the system's character is softly rounded.
Don't exceed 34px font size except for the auth page hero — the system speaks in measured voices.
Don't use more than one accent color family per screen — emerald leads; brand blue appears only for focus states.
Don't remove or alter GST-related terminology, calculations, or Indian market conventions.
Don't change the PDF document formats, numbering systems, or company branding elements during UI improvements.
